segments.contextAfter: In most cases, updating to a new scroller style is automatic: When the preferred scroller style changes, AppKit notifies all [`NSScrollView`](nsscrollview.md) instances, setting the [`scrollerStyle`](nsscroller/scrollerstyle.md) property of each with the new style, which causes each scroll view to automatically re-tile (update its layout) to adapt to the new scroller style.
